item.description: Following the NATO summit in Turkey in July, President Donald Trump was seen boarding a decoy Air Force One. The Washington Post reports that after boarding the plane, he was whisked away to a nearby aircraft using a catering truck. The ruse was reportedly used to conceal his whereabouts amid an ongoing assassination threat from Iran. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.
